## Functions With `return` As Parameter Name

```r
# `return` is not a reserved word in R (it's not in `?Reserved`), so it is
# allowed as a parameter name (#189).

function(return) return
function(return = 1) return
```

## Function Dots And Dot Dot I [pending]

```r
# Dots as parameter without default
function(...) { list(...) }

# Dots as parameter with default
function(... = 1) { get("...") }

# `..i` as parameter without default
function(..1) { get("..1") }

# `..i` as parameter with default
function(..1 = 1) { get("..1") }

# Miscellaneous
function(x, ...) f(...)
function(x, ...) ..1 + ..2
```

*Not yet supported.*

## A Hole In A Parameter List [error]

R accepts `f(a,,b)` and rejects `function(a,,b)`, so the identical shape is a
hole in an argument list and an error in a parameter list.

```r
function(a,,b) 1
function(a,) 1
function(,) 1
```

## A Parameter That Is Not A Name [error]

A string is a valid argument name and not a valid parameter name. Whatever
stands in a name's place is contained in an `RBogusParameterName`, which leaves
the parameter, the list, and the definition around it intact. A name is a single
token, so `a$b` is a name followed by rubbish rather than one bad name.

```r
function(1) x
function("a") x
function(a$b) x
```

## A Missing Comma Between Parameters [error]

A name is a single token, so the token after one may well be another parameter.
Reporting the separator without consuming anything keeps both.

```r
function(a b) x
```

```cst
RRoot {
    bom_token: missing (optional),
    statements: RStatementList [
        RStatement {
            expression: RFunctionDefinition {
                name: FUNCTION_KW@0..8 "function" [] [],
                parameters: RParameters {
                    l_paren_token: L_PAREN@8..9 "(" [] [],
                    items: RParameterList [
                        RParameter {
                            name: RIdentifier {
                                name_token: IDENT@9..11 "a" [] [Whitespace(" ")],
                            },
                            default: missing (optional),
                        },
                        missing separator,
                        RParameter {
                            name: RIdentifier {
                                name_token: IDENT@11..12 "b" [] [],
                            },
                            default: missing (optional),
                        },
                    ],
                    r_paren_token: R_PAREN@12..14 ")" [] [Whitespace(" ")],
                },
                body: RIdentifier {
                    name_token: IDENT@14..15 "x" [] [],
                },
            },
            semicolon_token: missing (optional),
        },
    ],
    eof_token: EOF@15..16 "" [Newline("\n")] [],
}
```

## A Default With No Value [error]

The default is required once an `=` is written (r-lib/tree-sitter-r#161).

```r
function(x = ) 1
```

```cst

    bom_token: missing (optional),
    statements: RStatementList [
        RStatement {
            expression: RFunctionDefinition {
                name: FUNCTION_KW@0..8 "function" [] [],
                parameters: RParameters {

                    items: RParameterList [
                        RParameter {
                            name: RIdentifier {
                                name_token: IDENT@9..11 "x" [] [Whitespace(" ")],

}
```
